responsibility: Provides the AVX10.2 media-style intrinsic interface for 128-bit and 256-bit vectors. It exposes narrow-width byte and word dot-product accumulate operations (`dpb*`, `dpw*`), packed FP16 dot products to FP32, and masked `mpsadbw` helpers, making it the AVX10.2 companion to the 512-bit media header for sub-512-bit neural-network and media arithmetic.
